posts.body: Hey. I'm spudz. I accidentally misspelled my named when I made my account. I used to play around in Rm2k/3 and XP when I was younger and spent a lot of time in the rpg maker forums lurking about and collecting resources. I recently caught 2003 on sale through steam and I've been diving back in. I'm working on some RTP based projects and working on building a Action CBS. Excited to play some games and see what the community has to offer. Anyway, nice to meet ya!
